ValidationRule.description: This validation will fire if Maker is updating the checker result
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Type , "Release Hold Amount"), AND( ISPICKVAL(Type , "New Bank Statement Request"), $User.Maker_Checker_Bypass_Flag__c = false ) ), ISCHANGED(cc_Checker_Result__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Checker_Result__c, "")), (Address_Updated_By__c = $User.Id), ($User.LastName <> "Integration") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Maker cannot update the Checker Result.
